en: A colorized vintage view of a broad urban square framed by historic multi‑story buildings, trees, and paths, backed by rocky hills and snowy mountains under a pink-and-blue sky. In the left foreground is a large monument in the center of a circular plaza; the right side shows several classical-style buildings facing the open square. At the top left, printed text reads "Trento  Piazza Dante," identifying the scene as Piazza Dante in Trento, with the surrounding Alpine landscape.
